newsitem.title: USA: Worldcom, MFS holders okay merger.
newsitem.headline: Worldcom, MFS holders okay merger.

text.p: MFS Communications Corp said on Monday its shareholders and WorldCom Inc shareholders approved the merger of the two companies at separate meetings.
Under terms of the deal, each share of MFS common stock would be converted into the right to receive 2.1 shares of WorldCom common stock, MFS said.

Each share of MFS' Series A 8 percent cumulative convertible preferred stock would be converted into the right to receive one share of Series A 8 percent cumulative convertible preferred stock of WorldCom, it said.
Each share of MFS' Series B Convertible Preferred Stock will be converted into the right to receive one share of Series B Convertible Preferred Stock of WorldCom, MFS said.
The merger is expected to be completed on December 31, 1996, MFS said.
